whatIs.title: What is SoftSchools?
paragraphs: SoftSchools is your digital school: a cloud system to manage schools, academies and educational institutions from one place.
It centralizes student records, school plans, courses, attendance, grades, messaging and finances so your team works with order — without scattered paperwork.
